messages:
claire: Partner asked for an official perf/W one-pager for the marketplace listing. Need a short, repeatable measurement protocol and who owns what.

nate: Proposal: primary power source = external PDU (preferred). Fallback = IPMI (annotate). Sample rate 250ms. Warmup = 60s; steady window = next 90s. Normalize final numbers to seq=256. Report tokens/sec, tokens/sec/W, p50/p90 latency, and power_resolution_ms.

vikram: Agreed. We'll run batches: 1, 8, 32, 128 and quant modes: fp16, q4_0. Also capture KV hit rate and batch distribution in telemetry. Add a single long-context check (seq=1024) for tail behavior.

claire: Acceptance gate idea: best-config toks/sec/W >= 85% of our certified baseline -> "Recommended"; 70-85% -> "Supported (reduced perf)"; <70% -> do not list. Also require smoke eval (100 prompts) with exact-match/logprob check.

nate: I'll own telemetry schema + partner wrapper script to align PDU/IPMI with runtime tel. Will open a PR with schema and an example parser.

vikram: I'll own kernel patch checklist and microbench harness. I'll propose up to 3 conservative changes (thread tuning, kv prefetch, async-copy) with expected deltas and risk labels. Each change must include a regression test.

ops-bot: Partner lab slot booked: lab-9 rp-5290005 on 2026-04-08 14:00 UTC. Logs will post to CI when run starts.

ops-bot: Run rp-5290005 started.

ops-bot: Run rp-5290005 finished.

nate: Quick summary from rp-5290005: seq256 batch32 q4_0 -> 408 toks/s, steady watts 195W => 2.09 toks/s/W. p50 13ms, p90 27ms. Raw artifacts: s3://partners/artifacts/5290005/tel.json and pdu.csv. PR opened: https://git.redwood/partners/telemetry/pulls/48

vikram: Patch matrix draft PR opened: https://git.redwood/partners/kernel/pulls/12. Microbench artifacts uploaded: s3://partners/artifacts/5290005/microbench/

claire: Good. Nate/Vikram please tag the rp id in PRs and include a one-line recommendation for the marketplace SKU. I'll assemble the one-pager once PRs are green and we pass the automated delta check. Schedule review Fri 9am PT. :thumbsup:
